reference.citation: Nunez PL et al. (1997). EEG coherency I: statistics, reference electrode, volume conduction. Electroenceph Clin Neurophysiol 103(5):499-515. Reference impl: scipy.signal.coherence (Virtanen et al. 2020). Data: EEG Motor Movement/Imagery Database (eegmmidb), PhysioNet.
reference.description: re-computes the pairwise magnitude-squared coherence matrix with scipy.signal.coherence (symmetric Hann, matched window length + overlap, detrend=False) band-averaged over 8-13 Hz, and reports the bit-exact scipy agreement over all 28 pairs, the mean/peak/minimum posterior alpha coherence, and the channel + pair counts
